notes.title: More Languages Are Supported & New Area Keeper: Spiky Boar
notes.content:
Hi guys! In this V7.5.2 update, we have made the following additions and improvements to the game: 

[h3]More languages supported: Traditional Chinese, Russian, and Japanese[/h3]
We are excited to announce that our localization work has been completed at this stage and that the game has gained its support for three more languages: Traditional Chinese, Russian and Japanese. You can switch languages at the "Settings"-"Language" option from the main menu.

[h3]New Monster: Spiky Boar[/h3]
Spiky Boars were a common species in the rainforest but have since become increasingly rare due to human pollution and hunting. Most of the Spiky Boars you will meet there now are amazingly huge variants. They are too fat to run, so they simply use their round bodies as pinballs, rolling and crushing the enemies. It now appears in Chapter 4: Ooze Forest and Chapter 5: Frozen Peak as area keepers.

Thanks for playing! Wish ya'll good luck in the adventure!

notes.title: New Mecha Monster: Lava Shooter
notes.content:
Hi guys! In this V7.5.1 update, we have made the following additions and improvements to the game:

[h3]New monster: Lava Shooter[/h3]
The Lava Shooter is a defensive mech made by the best mechanics of the kingdom. It is a big steel guy lazily floating in the air, spraying scorching lava towards the intruders. It now appears in Chapter 6: Deserted Factory and Chapter 7: Riot Capital as area keepers.

[h3]New monster: Shredder[/h3]
Shredders are small industrial machines used by dwarf workers to cut steel and wood. However, it is also very handy in cutting enemies... It can flexibly jump between the ceilings and the ground, so that cut at multiple angles! They appears in Chapter 6: Deserted Factory.

[h3]Menu Improvements[/h3]
1. We improved the layout of the Herobook, Monster Collection, and Runestone Stall. We also updated the hero illustrations.
2. We have improved the English translation quality of the game. Several languages will be added in subsequent updates, so stay tuned!

Thanks for playing! Wish ya'll good luck in the adventure!

notes.title: Double-jump operation, screen resolution & other improvements
notes.content:
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] We added a higher resolution support: 1366*768 (and is set default), which will give a clearer render of the game surface when playing in full-screen mode. If necessary, you can also switch back to the previous 1280*720 basic resolution in the Settings panel.
[*] We completely solved the previous problem of low framerate. Now the game should run very smoothly!
[*] A new wall tile style has been added to the tower in all main chapters. Towers now look more pretty!
[*] We changed the algorithm of hero jumping. We read through all the feedback from the players and realized that the previous double-jump operations were a bit hard to achieve, resulting in a very poor gaming experience. This will indeed be an excessively high barrier to players. Now, you can also initiate a second jump while falling. Double-jump is more flexible now. 
[*] We replaced and added some game sound effects (especially Chapter 2-it was really noisy before).
[*] We also improved the confusing highlighting problem in the tour merchant's purchasing panel.
[/list]

[h3]Content Adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Shield Spell" has been removed from the list of available items in Chapter 5-1.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem that heroes sometimes hang on the sidewall of the tower, and sometimes even gets outside the tower.
[*] Fixed the issue that the 12th wave in chapter 5-1 would be skipped.
[*] Fixed the crash of the program that happens when purchasing a servant in Chapter 5-1.
[*] Fixed the problem that heroes sometimes get stuck in the wall tiles.
[/list]

Except for the above major points, there are some more trivial visual and content improvements. Good luck in the adventure!

notes.title: Update: Now enter the world of "Wizard's Scroll"!
notes.content:
In today’s update, we have added a bunch of exciting new content!

[h3]New ink-painting theme chapter: Wizard's Scroll [/h3]
One of the grand wizard's secret treasures-the wonderful Magic Scroll, contains an independent mini world inside. The magic ink used in it can float and change magically. This scroll was originally used by the mage to record important stuffs, but recently it seems to be too rebellious. It escaped from the mage's treasure chest and flew far away. Finally, it is found in this graveyard.
It turned out that the administrator of the scroll proclaimed himself Scroll Lord and wanted to get rid of the control of the wizard! Why does the meek administrator suddenly possess such a sense of rebellion? You need to enter the scroll’s world, defeat the Scroll Lord, and find out the truth!
This chapter is a branch thread of Chapter 3. Players can play this branch after passing Chapter 3.

[h3]Previous Endless mode: remake[/h3]
We turned the previous endless mode into an "Endless-less" one. Now it is also a branch chapter (attached to Chapter 5). As long as you pass Chapter 5, you can play this chapter "The Guardian of the Stone Statue" freely!
The basic mechanism of this chapter has not changed. You still need to kill monsters coming to destroy and protect the king’s statue, but the total wave number is limited from "endless" to 20 waves.

[h3]New: Victory Bonus Award[/h3]
In order to award players more EXP who has completed a more difficult game, and at the same time to accelerate the upgrading speed of your heroes, we added the "Bonus EXP" mechanism to all chapters. The specific bonus values are as follows.
[list]
[*] Chapter 1 to 7: Easy complete +20, Normal complete +50, and Hard complete +100.
[*] Branch 3-1: Complete +20.
[*] Branch 5-1: Complete +50.
[/list]

[h3]Balance change[/h3]
The number of monsters in the first few levels has been greatly reduced, therefore it should be easier for new players to get started. At the same time, the difficulty of the last few levels is increased, so that the game can progress more reasonably.

[h3]New minor monster (Chapter 3): Scavenging Rat[/h3]
Don't think that the graveyard is full of slow skeletons or half-dead things. These giant rats are now the only "living" creatures that shuttle among the tombs! But they will not be friends with other "living" adventurers. They will cling to the enemy and bite frantically-so please don't get entangled by them.

The above is the main change of this update. Besides, we have made some other minor adjustments, and fixed some known bugs as well. Good luck in your adventure!

notes.title: New monster: Rock Worm & Other Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
Hi guys! In this update, we have made the following additions and improvements to the game:

1. New monster: Rock Worm
The Rock Worm is a giant underground monster that wriggles through deep caves. It is good at launching a sneak attack on defenseless passers, swallowing them, and then quickly retracts into the shelter of rocks. It will replace the (Two-headed) Hell Hound as the new area keeper for some areas in Chapter 2: Gloomy Cave.
Additionally, the Rock Worm will also temporarily serve as the area keeper for the graveyard and rainforest chapters. We will gradually design such unique regional guards for subsequent chapters that fit the chapter's features better.

2. Adventure mode: Tower structure adjusted
We expanded the original 5 areas per chapter to 6 or 7 areas. This will further reduce the monster density and thus the difficulty of the game. The total number of monsters has not changed.

3. Adventure mode: new chapter dialogue
Now, there is an NPC at the beginning of each chapter, and the player can choose to talk to him/her. In some chapters, special mechanisms might be triggered after such dialogues. For example, chapter 2: You will get 2 blasting detonators at the end of the dialogue; Chapter 7: You can get several ally reinforcements after the dialogue.

4. Balance Update
The bosses of all the chapters have increased their hitpoints by 200 to 400.

5. Visual Interface Improve
We optimized the layout of the Herobook, making the representation more tidy and user-friendly. The task panel has been moved from the index page to the chapter-selection page.

6. Other
Fixed some bugs which might occur in endless mode.
Improved some sound effects and character's voices.
Optimized the efficiency of the program, which should alleviate the previous problem of too low frame rate.

Thanks for playing! Wish ya'll good luck in the adventure!

notes.title: Bug Fix, Balance Change & More
notes.content:
In this small patch we made the following adjustments.

1. BUG FIX
Previously, when player tries to select goods from the tour merchant, the game quits incorrectly. We've now fixed that problem.

2. BALANCE CHANGE
We realized that even the first chapter is too difficult for most players. Of course, get familiarize with character's operations will help a lot; you can practice that in Practice Mode (which is on the top-right corner on the Chapter selecting page); or change keyboard bindings to fit your habits. 
However, the first chapter is still too HARSH. Now we've slightly reduced the number of monsters for all chapters, and increased the amount of chests by 1%. We believe that will work for you guys now.

3. Other
Besides, we've also improved some visual effects and the default wallpapers.

Thanks for playing! Good luck in your future adventure!
